messages:
alyssa_marketing: OK team — planning an OSS 'Community Labs' tutorial + tiny refapp launch next month. want to align on launch post, benchmark hooks, and webinar teaser routing. who can own the benchmark narrative?

mike_product: I can take the benchmark narrative. will need sample workloads and target p95 latency numbers from eng-runtime.

alyssa_marketing: thanks — can you sketch 2 angles: 1) low-latency for interactive apps, 2) cost-efficiency for batch embeddings. each needs a 1-paragraph hook for the blog and 3 tweet-sized bullets.

mike_product: yep. pinging @jess_devrel for workload + reference app artifacts.

jess_devrel: got it. I have the refapp (mini FAQ chat + embeddings demo) ready in the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-labs/refapp — will extract perf scripts.

jess_devrel: workloads: small-chat (seq len ~128, batch 1), embed-batch (2048 items, batch 32). rough perf from dry run: p95 85ms on t4-like, 42ms on A10-like for small-chat. embed throughput ~140 qps on batch32. will dump exact numbers to a google sheet.

sam_growth: routing + inbound: recommend a webinar signup page with a UTM per channel and an embed form that fires to our HubSpot in 'Community Labs' campaign. I'll own UTM map + form.

alyssa_marketing: sweet. sam can you also propose 3 headlines for the launch post? short + long + social variant.

sam_growth: ideas: 1) "Community Labs: A tiny refapp for low-latency chat + fast embeddings" 2) "Ship faster: build LLM features with our OSS refapp" 3) social: "Try the Community Labs refapp — demo + benchmark inside 👀"

mike_product: draft benchmark hook (short): "See how small-chat hits sub-100ms p95 on modern GPUs — and how batching for embeddings cuts cost by 3x. We share configs, scripts, and a reproducible refapp."

alyssa_marketing: good. jess — can you add a small HOWTO snippet for reproducing the numbers? code block please (3 lines max)

jess_devrel: sure: ```bash
# run small-chat perf
python perf.py --model redwood/crew-small --seq 128 --batch 1 --iters 100
python perf.py --embeddings --batch 32 --items 2048
```

sam_growth: inbound mapping: /webinar/community-labs -> utm_source=twitter|newsletter|oss_repos, event form triggers: tag=community-labs, owner=sam_growth, followup email template id=CL-01

alyssa_marketing: can publish timeline: draft blog by Mon (3 days), assets + screenshots Tue, social copy Wed, webinar signups open Thu. agree?

mike_product: agree. I'll have benchmark sheet by end of day tomorrow.

jess_devrel: will push refapp release branch + CHANGELOG and short demo GIFs by Tue EOD.

publish_bot: scheduled_post created: draft saved at /marketing/drafts/community-labs-launch.md — reminder set for 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC

alyssa_marketing: :thumbsup: ok team — we'll sync Wed 10am to finalize copy. tagging this thread as the single source for assets.
